items.question: Can I get flu and COVID shots together?
items.answer: Yes. Both can be given in the same visit, one in each arm.

items.question: Is there a cost without insurance?
items.answer: Flu shots are $35 self-pay. Ask us about free community clinics for COVID boosters.
